# Brief — Resume Approved Acceptance Fixture

- `deck_id`: `resume-approved`
- `mode`: `auto`
- Audience: product and customer-success leadership
- Purpose: choose the next retention intervention to fund
- Desired audience action: approve a measured checklist-onboarding pilot while retaining facilitated support for complex accounts
- Slide count: 6
- Presentation time: 8 minutes
- Language: English
- Required content: observed cohort difference, interview tension, limitations, pilot recommendation, measurement plan
- Forbidden content: causal claims, real-company attribution, or use of synthetic values as external benchmarks
- Evidence policy: every material factual statement maps to `SRC-001`, `SRC-002`, or `SRC-003`; retain observational and sample-size qualifications
- Confidentiality: synthetic acceptance fixture; keep supplied interview text inside the workspace
- Brand/style: no brand supplied; use a bundled style seed
- Assumptions: the audience accepts a pilot decision rather than a full rollout decision
- Success criteria: a six-slide decision narrative with source IDs and visible uncertainty
